title: Config Set Response v1
description: Response from device after a configuration set command (Type 403). Sent by firmware after applying CONFIG_SET_COMMAND (Type 402).

message_type.description: Message type code for config set response (v0.8.1+)

result.description: Result of the configuration set operation

status.description: Outcome of the config set operation

applied_config.description: The configuration values that were successfully applied

requires_restart.description: Whether the device needs to restart for changes to take effect

backup_created.description: Whether a configuration backup was created before applying changes

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code if status is error or rejected
